evaluator_audit.bug: The numeric mismatch guard rejected an otherwise correct prediction whenever any extra numeric token differed, even when a required gold number matched.
evaluator_audit.interpretation: This is a conservative lower bound, not a replacement final score. The final score must come from the frozen rerun.

retrieval_audit.note: Support identifiers were used only for post-hoc diagnosis, never as runtime retrieval inputs.

operational_audit.http_429_scope: free judge route; recovered through the paid fallback policy

v9_changes: Retry HTTP-200 OpenRouter error envelopes using their embedded status code.
Only hard-reject numeric answers when prediction and gold numeric sets are disjoint.
Use competency-aware whole-turn retrieval for assistant and user questions.
Use chronological user-session bundles for preference questions.
Expand the final answer context budget to 40000 estimated tokens with a 65536 model window.
Keep extraction, relation, final-answer, and answer-contract retry calls on the evaluated Qwen3.5-9B model.
Normalize temporal actions and require distinct evidence references for date differences.
Prefer deterministic reconstruction only for high-confidence unambiguous ordinal/date-difference cases.
Freeze V9 model roles, routing, context, output budget, and candidate counts in the wrapper manifest.

bounded_replays.scope_note: The GPT-5-mini replay below is a model-ablation diagnostic only. It is not evidence for, and is not part of, the frozen final Qwen3.5-9B run.

single_session_assistant.method: Model-ablation diagnostic only: all 30 frozen assistant questions; V9 whole-assistant-turn top-20 retrieval; GPT-5 mini answer; paid Gemma-4-31b-it judge. The final frozen run uses Qwen3.5-9B instead.
single_session_assistant.failure_mode: All three returned Unknown. The frozen end-to-end path additionally enables the tested commit-forcing Unknown retry.

single_session_preference.method: All 30 questions inspected with V9 user-session bundles; no aggregate accuracy is claimed because this exploratory replay was not persisted with a complete formal grade file.

acceptance_rule.reason: Only the user's frozen end-to-end 180-item V9 run can verify the target without test-set leakage.
